question: A charge is given separately to a metal sphere and to a plastic sphere. Predict how the charge is distributed in each case. Justify your answer.

options.A: Charge remains localized on both metal and plastic spheres because all solids are insulators
options.B: Charge spreads over the plastic sphere but remains localized on the metal sphere
options.C: Charge disappears immediately from both spheres
options.D: On the metal sphere, charge spreads over the surface because free charges can move; on the plastic sphere, it remains mainly localized where supplied because charges cannot move freely
